title: Apache Tomcat Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2017-12617 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-03-25
body: When running Apache Tomcat, it is possible to upload a JSP file to the server via a specially crafted request. This JSP could then be requested and any code it contained would be executed by the server. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Network Share Discovery
sub: T1135 · discovery
body: Adversaries may look for folders and drives shared on remote systems as a means of identifying sources of information to gather as a precursor for Collection and to identify potential systems of interest for Lateral Movement. Networks often contain shared network drives and folders that enable users to access file directories on various systems across a network. File sharing over a Windows network occurs over the SMB protocol. Net can be used to query a remote system for available shared drives using the net view \\\\remotesystem command. It can also be used to query shared drives on the local system using net share. For macOS, the sharing -l command lists all shared points used for smb…

title: D-Link DIR-820 Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2023-25280 · exploited in the wild, listed 2024-09-30
body: D-Link DIR-820 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ping_addr parameter to ping.ccp. What to do: The impacted product is end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue utilization of the product.

title: Qlik Sense HTTP Tunneling Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2023-48365 · exploited in the wild, listed 2025-01-13 · used by ransomware
body: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: Dahua IP Camera Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2021-33045 · exploited in the wild, listed 2024-08-21
body: Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the loopback device is specified by the client during authentication. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: QNAP NAS Improper Authorization Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2021-28799 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-03-31 · used by ransomware
body: QNAP NAS running HBS 3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability which can allow remote attackers to log in to a device. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Cache Poisoning
sub: CAPEC-141 · likelihood: high
body: An attacker exploits the functionality of cache technologies to cause specific data to be cached that aids the attackers' objectives. This describes any attack whereby an attacker places incorrect or harmful material in cache. The targeted cache can be an application's cache (e.g. a web browser cache) or a public cache (e.g. a DNS or ARP cache). Until the cache is refreshed, most applications or clients will treat the corrupted cache value as valid. This can lead to a wide range of exploits including redirecting web browsers towards sites that install malware and repeatedly incorrect calculations based on the incorrect value.

title: Buffer Overflow via Parameter Expansion
sub: CAPEC-47 · likelihood: medium
body: In this attack, the target software is given input that the adversary knows will be modified and expanded in size during processing. This attack relies on the target software failing to anticipate that the expanded data may exceed some internal limit, thereby creating a buffer overflow.

title: GitLab Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2021-22175 · exploited in the wild, listed 2026-02-18
body: GitLab contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability when requests to the internal network for webhooks are enabled. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: Adobe ColdFusion Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2018-15961 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-11-03
body: Adobe ColdFusion contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could allow for code execution. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: VDSO Hijacking
sub: T1055.014 · stealth, privilege escalation
body: Adversaries may inject malicious code into processes via VDSO hijacking in order to evade process-based defenses as well as possibly elevate privileges. Virtual dynamic shared object (vdso) hijacking is a method of executing arbitrary code in the address space of a separate live process. VDSO hijacking involves redirecting calls to dynamically linked shared libraries. Memory protections may prevent writing executable code to a process via Ptrace System Calls. However, an adversary may hijack the syscall interface code stubs mapped into a process from the vdso shared object to execute syscalls to open and map a malicious shared object. title: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2020-6819 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-11-03
body: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a race condition vulnerability when running the nsDocShell destructor under certain conditions. The race condition creates a use-after-free vulnerability, causing unspecified impacts. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Token Impersonation
sub: CAPEC-633
body: An adversary exploits a weakness in authentication to create an access token (or equivalent) that impersonates a different entity, and then associates a process/thread to that that impersonated token. This action causes a downstream user to make a decision or take action that is based on the assumed identity, and not the response that blocks the adversary.

title: Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2019-11634 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-11-03 · used by ransomware
body: Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows contains remote code execution vulnerability resulting from local drive access preferences not being enforced into the clients' local drives. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2021-21972 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-11-03 · used by ransomware
body: VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Apple iOS Memory Corruption Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2019-7287 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-05-23
body: Apple iOS contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: XSS Using MIME Type Mismatch
sub: CAPEC-209
body: An adversary creates a file with scripting content but where the specified MIME type of the file is such that scripting is not expected. The adversary tricks the victim into accessing a URL that responds with the script file. Some browsers will detect that the specified MIME type of the file does not match the actual type of its content and will automatically switch to using an interpreter for the real content type. If the browser does not invoke script filters before doing this, the adversary's script may run on the target unsanitized, possibly revealing the victim's cookies or executing arbitrary script in their browser.

title: WatchGuard Firebox Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2025-9242 · exploited in the wild, listed 2025-11-12
body: WatchGuard Firebox contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: VMware ESXi Arbitrary Write Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2025-22225 · exploited in the wild, listed 2025-03-04 · used by ransomware
body: VMware ESXi contains an arbitrary write vulnerability. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with privileges within the VMX process to trigger an arbitrary kernel write leading to an escape of the sandbox. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: Oversized Serialized Data Payloads
sub: CAPEC-231 · likelihood: medium
body: An adversary injects oversized serialized data payloads into a parser during data processing to produce adverse effects upon the parser such as exhausting system resources and arbitrary code execution.

title: Exploitation of Improperly Controlled Hardware Security Identifiers
sub: CAPEC-681 · likelihood: medium
body: An adversary takes advantage of missing or incorrectly configured security identifiers (e.g., tokens), which are used for access control within a System-on-Chip (SoC), to read/write data or execute a given action.

title: Micro Focus Operation Bridge Report (OBR) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2021-22502 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-11-03
body: Micro Focus Operation Bridge Report (OBR) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Cisco IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software Quality of Service Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2018-0151 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-03-03
body: A vulnerability in the quality of service (QoS) subsystem of Cisco IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition or execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Action Spoofing
sub: CAPEC-173 · likelihood: high
body: An adversary is able to disguise one action for another and therefore trick a user into initiating one type of action when they intend to initiate a different action. For example, a user might be led to believe that clicking a button will submit a query, but in fact it downloads software. Adversaries may perform this attack through social means, such as by simply convincing a victim to perform the action or relying on a user's natural inclination to do so, or through technical means, such as a clickjacking attack where a user sees one interface but is actually interacting with a second, invisible, interface.

title: Process Argument Spoofing
sub: T1564.010 · stealth
body: Adversaries may attempt to hide process command-line arguments by overwriting process memory. Process command-line arguments are stored in the process environment block (PEB), a data structure used by Windows to store various information about/used by a process. The PEB includes the process command-line arguments that are referenced when executing the process. When a process is created, defensive tools/sensors that monitor process creations may retrieve the process arguments from the PEB. Adversaries may manipulate a process PEB to evade defenses.
